source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read from a git fetch of the pinned commit and hashed as a Git blob; computed OID matches the source map. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

claims.evidence: Nine components and their roles from the source body; the API gateway role read from a local clone of Microsoft's architecture-center; five costs measured by a Python 3.13.16 program on a 4-vCPU virtual machine with Redis 7.0.15 and standard-library HTTP servers, three runs, 2026-10-19. The 'cost when added' column is the author's inference, not the source's. Gateway, service layer, data storage and the visualisation/search halves of metrics and logs were not measured.

claims.claim_vi: Source: nine components - API gateway (routing, filtering, load balancing), service registry, service layer, authorization server, data storage, distributed caching, async communication, metrics visualization, log aggregation and visualization - with example product names.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Microsoft: an API gateway is a centralized entry point acting as a reverse proxy, routing requests to services and performing cross-cutting tasks such as authentication, SSL termination and rate limiting; gateway aggregation combines several client requests into one to reduce chattiness.
claims.section: What is an API gateway?; How to use an API gateway
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: Measured costs on one machine (three runs): calling a service with a cached address 179-206 us versus 507-559 us when the registry is queried before every call; verifying a token signature locally 1.8 us versus 192-223 us asking an authorization server over HTTP; Redis GET 39-40 us versus an in-process sqlite3 read 1-2 us (memory) and 5 us (file); a request doing 5 ms of work inline 5,116-5,127 us versus 36-40 us pushing the job to a Redis list (5,500 jobs left in the queue in each run); a locked counter increment 0.23-0.24 us; one INFO log line to a file 11.7-13.1 us and a dropped debug call 0.17-0.18 us.
claims.verified_by: Program run by the author on 2026-10-19; loopback network, so each network hop is cheaper than between machines.

design_notes_vi: Ba khung: chín thành phần, năm cái giá đo được, bốn thành phần chưa đo.
source_deviations: The source is a diagram with one short paragraph and product names per component; the lesson keeps the nine components, drops the product names, adds a cost column (inference) and five measurements.
Three components (gateway, service layer, data store) are labelled as not measured; six components are covered by the five measurements (metrics and logs share one).
